Real sessions · real database · real reports
The AI data analyst, in operation

Ask the data. Get the answer, the analysis, and the report.

This is an AI agent with live access to a real multi-dataset database: a 60,000-row NYC collision set for the demo sessions below, backed by a 57.8M-row scale tier (22.5M NYC 311 requests, 16.9M Dutch vehicles, 8.6M Chicago crimes, 5M census records, 4.6M Amazon reviews). It profiles, cleans, analyzes, forecasts, and writes the report files itself. The sessions below are its actual runs, unedited. Every number came from a query the agent ran, or was computed from one. A later self-audit re-ran all 92 recorded queries (all reproduced) and found one arithmetic error, a total in the Dutch fleet session; it is documented in AUDIT.md.

How the agent works

ConnectsRead-only access to your database (SQLite here; same pattern for Postgres/BigQuery). The database stays on the machine; query results, including sample rows, are sent to the AI model (Ollama Cloud) to reason over.
Profiles firstIt never assumes: row counts, nulls, duplicates, format chaos, and column meanings get checked before a single conclusion is drawn.
Analyses on commandSQL for facts, Python for modeling, its forecast tool always compares against a naive baseline and reports honest 80% bands.
Delivers filesThe report is the product: PDF, Excel, and Word deliverables generated in-session, numbers-first and limitations included.

Where the data comes from

All public, licensed data — traceable to its official source. The full manifest with direct download links lives in DATA-SOURCES.md in the repository.

NYC Motor Vehicle CollisionsNYC Open Data. The demo database: ~60k recent crash records via the Socrata API.
US Census ACS PUMS 2023Person and household microdata (5M+ records, survey-weighted) for demographics and economics at scale.
Chicago Crimes 2001-present8.6M reported incidents — event-stream analysis at scale.
NYC 311 Service Requests22.5M requests — operations and resolution-time analysis at scale.
Amazon Reviews 2023 (UCSD)~20M e-commerce reviews + product metadata — ratings, pricing, and consumer behavior.
RDW Dutch Vehicle Registry16.9M registered vehicles (CC-0) — the electrification and fleet-age story.

Honesty notes: the demo database is public NYC Open Data (motor vehicle collisions, retrieved Sept 2026) with a synthetic legacy-export layer (duplicates, mixed formats) standing in for a client's messy copy. The agent's reasoning loop is the same one that powers Hermes Agent (Nous Research) — profile first, cite row counts, compare against baselines, disclose limits. AI-assisted workflow disclosure applies.
